name: shadowscan
description: AI Governance & Shadow AI Detection Platform

scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm:dev:api" "npm:dev:web"
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build --workspace @shadowscan/api && npm run build --workspace @shadowscan/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
